# Markups

> Free, open-source, browser Markdown editor with Monaco editing and live preview. No signup.

## Important limitations
PDF export is image-based, not searchable/selectable text. Word-compatible .doc is HTML-based and is not native .docx. Markdown extensions such as Mermaid and KaTeX need compatible renderers. Normal writing uses browser storage; optional AI features can send user-selected text to model providers.

## Editorial scope
The Markdown guide lists features checked in current source. No public, committed Markups feature roadmap was found on 2026-11-04, so unshipped features are not presented as promises.
